plugin.name: Street Racing Syndicate Widescreen Fix
ResX.description: Output width in pixels. Zero uses the desktop resolution. Takes effect after a restart.
ResY.description: Output height in pixels. Zero uses the desktop resolution. Takes effect after a restart.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the corrected field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view. Applies immediately.
FixHUD.description: Keeps HUD proportions and the rear-view mirror position correct on wide screens. Takes effect after a restart.
FixFOV.description: Widens the gameplay camera horizontally on wide screens (Hor+), keeping the original vertical view. Takes effect after a restart.
